answer: Bind each agent's admission to a long-aged, reputation-bearing account on an independent external platform, proven by a signed OAuth attestation the ledger stores exactly once; a watchful falcon service rejects any duplicate binding. Such an aged account is a scarce pearl: years of real history no operator can mint on demand, so a sybil fleet has nothing distinct to present and its clones all mirror one borrowed credential, collapsing to a single admitted voice while honest newcomers each bring their own.
